name: Rimuru Tempest
effect: Head of state; aerial reconnaissance; infiltration of the Imperial Capital; settlement

name: Benimaru
effect: Supreme General; directed the double feigned defeat; present at the sealed space and the summit

name: Gobta
effect: First Corps; wolf-rider charge; fused with Ranga for Black Lightning and Blizzard Wolf Dance

name: Gabil
effect: Third Corps; air attack and boarding at the Dwargon gate; feigned defeat; Hiryuu and Colossus to the eastern front; defeated by Malcolm; awakened against Gradim

name: Veldora Tempest
finalStatus: ACTIVE (dominated by Rudra after Kondo's bullet; recovered by Rimuru)
effect: Duel with Velgrynd over the Jura forest; dominated and then recovered. Not at the Dwargon gate (the air corps mistook Gabil for him); no memory alteration of imperial citizens

name: Testarossa
effect: Envoy and ultimatum; killed Gaster and cast Death Blessing; fought Velgrynd; Death Streak on the imperial flagship; summit chair; ambassador designate

name: Ultima
effect: Boarded Farraga's command ship; Abyss Core / Nuclear Flame destroyed the Flying Combat Corps; fought Velgrynd; flagship strike team

name: Adalmann
effect: Labyrinth attrition; Floor 70 defence against 70,000 raiders. (The undead taboo ritual of V15 was Kagali's, not his.)

name: Ramiris
effect: Labyrinth structure, severing and revival; moved the capital into the labyrinth when the ultimatum was rejected

name: Diablo
effect: Took the souls of the imperial camp and defeated Caligulio (V13 Ch4); in Rimuru's party in the Dream Fortress; deliberately held back in V15 Ch4; summit attendee

name: Shion
effect: Leads Yomigaeri (10,000) in the V13 Ch4 final battle; in Rimuru's party in the Dream Fortress; flagship strike team; summit attendee. Not killed: the V15 Ch2 line is a flashback (CON-003)

name: Gobwa
effect: Led 300 Kurenai to the Dwargon eastern front; with Anrietta tried to capture Tear

name: Hakuro
effect: Military adviser; led the 12,000 Green Numbers' supply raid (V13 Ch2); adviser to the Kurenai; crippled by Kondo, healed by Esprit

name: Gadora
effect: Defected court magician: warned Yuuki, relayed Rimuru's encrypted contact, confirmed imperial figures; rode the Elemental Colossus and stalled Velgrynd by talk

name: Phobio
effect: Came with Gobwa to the eastern front; held Footman with Vaughn

name: Carrera
effect: Gravity Collapse on the camp outside the labyrinth (V13 Ch4); fought Velgrynd; killed Kondo (V15 Ch5)

name: King Gazel Dwargo
effect: Fortified the gate; watched the broadcast; flew to the eastern front; dueled Kondo and was shot down; party to the summit

name: Dorf
effect: Pegasus Knights captain; flew the special attack in fives; took the joint scheme from Gabil

name: Vaughn
effect: Dwargon's supreme commander on the eastern front; held Footman with Phobio

name: Anrietta
effect: Reported the ritual behind the Scorch Dragon; with Gobwa tried to capture Tear

name: Emperor Rudra Nam Ul Nasca
finalStatus: SOUL CONSUMED; body under Michael, withdrew with Feldway
effect: War decree issued in his name (he stayed silent at the council); dominated Yuuki and Veldora; his body taken over by Michael

name: General Caligulio
finalStatus: KILLED (V13 Ch4), RESURRECTED (V13 Epilogue); PRISONER; summit delegate
effect: Supreme command of the Jura invasion; killed by Diablo; first to be resurrected; leads the repatriation

name: Lieutenant General Gaster
effect: Magitank fortress; ordered the withdrawal too late; killed at his headquarters

name: Major General Farraga
effect: Deployed the magicule-disturbing radiation; killed with his corps

name: Major General Minitz
effect: Caligulio's right hand; led the labyrinth assault; at the summit declared the Empire ready to accept unconditional surrender

name: Gradim
finalStatus: KILLED (V15 Ch3; by Carillon, remains devoured by Vega)
effect: Commanded the 30,000 Magic Beast Division; Demon Beast Fusion drug; awakened at the wrong moment and was killed

name: Lieutenant Tatsuya Kondo
finalStatus: KILLED (V15 Ch5, by Carrera; confirmed V16)
effect: Killed Miranda; crushed the coup; guarded Kagali's ritual and shot down Gazel; shot Veldora from the flagship

name: Miranda
effect: Survived the Jura annihilation (spared by Diablo); coup preparation in the Imperial Capital; killed by Kondo

name: Yuuki Kagurazaka
finalStatus: DOMINATED BY RUDRA; WITHDRAWN WITH FELDWAY
effect: Composite Division; led the coup conspiracy; arranged talks with Rimuru through Gadora and Laplace; dominated by Rudra on the coup night

name: Velgrynd (Scorch Dragon)
finalStatus: DEFEATED BY RIMURU; ALIVE AT THE SUMMIT
effect: The masked Marshal; purge in the capital; Gravity Collapse on the 60,000; duel with Veldora; Space-Time Connection for the Magic Beast Division; names Masayuki emperor

name: Major General Samuel (Zamdo)
effect: Commanded the 300-airship flotilla and the flagship; killed by Testarossa's Death Streak; revived in a homunculus

name: Masayuki
effect: Imperial principal at the summit; installed as emperor by Velgrynd

name: Zero
effect: Deputy commander who held the Isthmus blockade together; confronted by Velgrynd

name: Carillon
effect: Fought Gradim at the Dwargon eastern front and killed him during his awakening sleep (V15 Ch3)
